description:
Create an alert rule on a token

Creates one threshold alert on one token for the signed-in wallet and returns it (201). When the rule's condition is met, an alert fires and is delivered on the wallet's notification channels; it does not fire again for `cooldownMinutes` (default 60).

`alertType` picks the metric, and `thresholdOperator` + `thresholdValue` the condition: `gt`/`lt` compare the metric to the value, `pct_drop`/`pct_spike` compare its percentage change (over `timeWindowMinutes` when set) to the value. Types and the lowest plan that may create them: `heartbeat_score` (Free; EVM tokens only; needs a token page), `copycat_detected` (Free; needs a token page), `holder_count_drop`, `liquidity_drop`, `volume_anomaly`, `price_change` (Pro), `top10_concentration` (Pro+; operator `gt` or `pct_spike` only). Free accounts hold up to 3 rules, paid plans 50, Enterprise unlimited.

The token is named by `chainId` + `tokenAddress`; a ticker is not accepted. A type above the caller's plan is 403, naming the plan, with `upgrade_url`; a token-page type on a token with no page is 400 `crown_required`. Each call creates a new rule, so the same request twice makes two rules.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy, allowing changes (scope api:write).

alertType.description:
What the rule watches, and the lowest plan that may create it: `heartbeat_score` (Free, EVM only, needs a
token page), `copycat_detected` (Free, needs a token page), `holder_count_drop`, `liquidity_drop`,
`volume_anomaly`, `price_change` (Pro), `top10_concentration` (Pro+).

chainId.description: Chain key (`base`), numeric id or CAIP-2 id (`eip155:8453`)

thresholdOperator.description:
`gt` / `lt`: the metric is above / below `thresholdValue`. `pct_drop` / `pct_spike`: the metric fell / rose by
at least `thresholdValue` percent. `top10_concentration` accepts only `gt` and `pct_spike`.

thresholdValue.description: Must be greater than 0. A percentage for `pct_drop`/`pct_spike`.

tokenAddress.description: 0x token address on EVM; the mint address on Solana (case-sensitive)
